in_marathi.name: Sharvishaana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Good Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvishaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharvishaana is the embodiment of good fortune and prosperity. She is invoked for success, happiness, and abundance in all areas of life. Her name consists of 'Sharvi' meaning 'Goddess of Fortune' and 'Shana' meaning 'Goddess of Grace'.
